plugins.name: contributory-factors
plugins.description: Replaces 'root cause' thinking with contributory factors analysis based on the London Protocol 2024 and the Yorkshire Contributory Factors Framework.

plugins.name: reportlab-pdf
plugins.description: ReportLab-based PDF generation. Two skills: programmatic Platypus PDFs (CVs, invoices, reports) and a markdown-to-PDF renderer (mistune + Platypus).

plugins.name: agent-team-topologies
plugins.description: Reusable Claude Code agent team topology patterns. Includes the topology selector skill (interactive decision tree across 8 patterns: Parallel Explorers, Review Board, Competing Hypotheses, Feature Pod, Risky Refactor, Orchestrator-Only, Quality-Gated, Task Queue) plus 6 specialist subagents (explorer, architect, implementer, security-reviewer, perf-reviewer, test-reviewer).

plugins.name: civi-mcp
plugins.description: Read-only access to CiviCRM via APIv4. Bundles an MCP server with four generic query tools (list_entities, describe_entity, get, count) and a companion skill providing workflow heuristics and CRM domain knowledge. Prompts for site URL and API key at install time; the key is stored in the system keychain.

plugins.name: lastlight-pr-gate
plugins.description: Stops unreviewed commits reaching a remote: every push needs a local Last Light PR review recorded at that exact SHA, run with Last Light's own review skill pulled from npm.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Two PreToolUse hooks on the Bash tool. The first refuses shell commands that are known-wrong on this machine and hands back the correct form: recursive grep, which, find -name, legacy toolchains, bash-only syntax that fails silently under zsh, and an unrecoverable rm -rf whose targets are not all disposable. The second gates git push -- it fetches the remote default branch (best-effort, 15s timeout) and DENIES a push whose branch is not a descendant of it, so a stale branch is rebased before the push rather than after CI has run against the wrong base. Pushing the default branch, deletions, tag-only pushes and --dry-run are not gated; opt a repo out with "touch $(git rev-parse --git-dir)/git-rebase-gate-off".
